snapshot.name: ak:advise
snapshot.description: Interview until user and agent share the same picture of the outcome, preview it visually, then deliver evidence-backed technical advice. Use for advisory interviews and second opinions; implementation belongs to a delivery workflow.
snapshot.when_to_use: Invoke when the user wants honest advice, a second opinion, requirement reframing, or an interview that pressure-tests an existing plan, design, or proposal — before planning or implementation.
